title: Dice ladder
description: Weapon damage dice in order, one die size per step (docs/modules/weapons.md). A size step moves a weapon's dice one rung; dice on the same rung count as the same step.

items.description: One rung. The first dice is what a size step lands on; the others share the rung.

size_steps.description: Rungs a weapon's size moves its dice.
